title: Compact Microtrace Summary Cards & Timeline Scrubber for Rapid Triage
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Problem: Support engineers and SREs spend too long opening full trace details to decide whether a request needs deep investigation. Existing trace view surfaces lots of spans and a large waterfall but requires multiple clicks and context switching. Goal: create a compact, scannable microtrace summary UI that sits at the top of the request drill-down and provides a fast triage path (summary score, top affected services, shortest sparklines for latency, correlation IDs, and a timeline scrubber that previews span clusters).
proposal: Introduce a horizontal strip (Microtrace Summary) above the existing trace canvas containing: 1) Summary card (anomaly score, error badge, request latency percentile) 2) Service chips with miniature sparkline thumbnails for each top-5 service in the call graph 3) Correlation ID quick-copy and outward links to related requests 4) Compact timeline scrubber that shows span density heatmap and supports hover-preview of 250ms clip and click-to-focus on span group. The microtrace should be keyboard accessible and collapse into a compact 'mini mode' for small viewports.
tradeoffs_and_considerations: - Prefetching span snippets for scrub hover increases frontend memory; will limit to first 8KB per trace. - Sparklines are simplified (aggregated mean/95th) to avoid rendering full span shapes for very long traces. - Must avoid duplicating heavy fetches: reuse existing trace retrieval API with a new ?summary=true param to return precomputed metrics. - Accessibility: provide textual equivalents for sparkline trends and ensure scrubber is operable with arrow keys.
design_workflow: 1) Low-fidelity wireframes -> 2) Figma interactive prototype (micro-interactions for scrub hover and clip preview) -> 3) Usability session with 4 SREs -> 4) Iterate -> 5) Handoff to ENG with annotated specs and acceptance tests.
acceptance_criteria: Microtrace strip appears at top of request drill-down for traces > 5 spans
Hovering scrubber shows a 250ms preview clip with timestamps
Clicking a service chip focuses trace canvas on that service's spans
Copy correlation ID button copies full ID and logs analytic event
Performance: additional API call for summary must return under 120ms p95 in staging
